market.summary: Kenya has large university collections, a national bibliographic institution and county/community public libraries. Koha is the strongest evidenced reusable LMS opportunity, while live policy and reachability barriers materially reduce immediately verifiable coverage. Six institutions returned book records; five are selected feasibility targets and one smaller reserve. Only four selected targets returned positive physical holdings for the sampled record; Strathmore is bibliographic-only.
market.platform_strategy: Start a bounded Koha compatibility pilot with UEAB, AIU, Daystar and Scott; hold Strathmore physical availability until holdings feed is explained. Treat KNLS WebCat as a strategic national union opportunity requiring endpoint, participants and per-library holdings validation. Reuse is a candidate, not a completed integration. Legacy V-smart/Iguana, SirsiDynix, Liberty and AMLIB evidence does not justify a universal connector.

limitations: No national largest-ten ranking established; dates, formats, institutional proxies and collection units are not comparable.
Five selected targets instead of ten after major libraries and meaningful alternatives; the one reserve is not promoted to fill the gap.
Strathmore is a real book-record success with explicitly zero physical items for the sampled edition, not a physical-availability success.
Daystar selected on official multi-library institutional proxy; no current numeric volume total verified.
Most source evidence is indexed official text or web-tool extraction; HTTP query evidence is independently saved bounded raw responses.
Public anonymous search does not establish borrowing rights, reuse licence or real-time circulation accuracy.
All checks are a dated single research session; no production adapter, app test, authentication, outreach or holds performed.
Failed, blocked and empty checks do not establish that a book is absent.
KNLS now reports headquarters plus two branches; old64/66branch figures are not current KNLS scope.
The historical Koha study and this selected sample are not national LMS market shares.
